sections.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains the concept of the Shechinah's descent and the transformation of folly into holiness through the Mishkan.

translations.translation: "I have come to My garden,"
"My sister, My bride,"
And it is explained by the Rebbe, my father-in-law, the Rebbe of the hillula, in the maamar,
According to the explanation in the Midrash,
"To My garden" means "to My bridal chamber,"
To the place which was My primary [dwelling] initially,
For the primary dwelling of the Shechinah was in the lower realms,
For at the beginning of creation, the world was created in its fullness,
And through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge and the sins that followed, they removed the Shechinah from below upward, up to the seventh firmament,
And the righteous, through their service, drew down the Shechinah from above downward,
For the beginning of the drawing down was from Avraham,
Who was the first,
And he brought it down from the seventh firmament to the sixth, etc., until Moshe, who is the seventh, and all sevenths are beloved,
And he brought it down from the first firmament below to the earth,
Therefore, to Moshe it is said,
"And they shall make Me a Sanctuary, and I will dwell in their midst,"
Which, in its simple sense, refers to the drawing down of G‑dliness that was below on earth,
And also as the saying of our Rabbis, of blessed memory,
"It does not say 'in it' but rather 'in their midst,'"
Within each and every one of Israel,
And according to this, it is explained in the maamar,
The reason why the Mishkan,
For "Mishkan is the Sanctuary, and the Sanctuary is the Mishkan,"
Was made of acacia wood,
For "shittim" is from the term "shtut" (folly),
As it is written,
"The people strayed,"
And it is the deviation from the straight and moderate path,
Which exists in two modes,
Deviation from the moderate path to the negative and deviation from the moderate path to the good,
That the deviation to the negative is as our Rabbis, of blessed memory, said,
"A person does not commit a transgression unless a spirit of folly enters into him,"

And this folly, which is the folly of the world and the folly of the side of impurity, must be transformed into the aspect of the folly of holiness, which is the service that is above reason and intellect,
And this is,
(The transformation from the folly of the side of impurity to the folly of holiness)
The primary service of the Mishkan and the Sanctuary,
Through which is fulfilled "and I will dwell in their midst,"
So that the primary dwelling of the Shechinah will be in the lower realms,
"I have come to My garden, to My bridal chamber."
And according to this, it is also explained in the maamar,
The reason why the acacia wood is called by the name "kerashim" (planks),
For all the names in the Torah are precise and correspond to the content of their subject,
For behold, the letters of "keresh" are the letters of "sheker" (falsehood) and the letters of "kesher" (knot),
And this means that from the falsehood of the world, one must transform them and make from them the planks of the Mishkan,
The aspect of a knot,
Meaning to bind all matters of the world to the Shechinah and to the essence of the Shechinah, which is the innerness and Atzmus of Ein Sof, blessed is He.
And as is explained in detail regarding the letters kuf and reish, and how they correspond in holiness,
And that one must transform them from the letters as they are in the "letters of falsehood"
To matters of good and holiness,
As all the above is explained at length in the previous sections.
